sent_messages.subject: Cancellation Confirmation
sent_messages.body: Dear Laura, I am writing to confirm that your reservation has been cancelled through the messaging agent. Please be advised that this cancellation is final and no further action is required on your part. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for your business. Sincerely, [Your Name]
